_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture 20260801145119 / 20260801145124). Two shots per weapon: SELECT PRIMARY WEAPON for the text and stats, CUSTOMIZE for the art. TBD is deliberate: anything not legible on screen stays TBD rather than becoming a plausible-looking guess. Unlock and Requirement transcribed from the in-game challenge text (source: Battlefield 6), recorded 2026-08-01.
name: B36A4

description.text: A versatile rifle that can be modified to compete in both close-quarters or ranged encounters.

compatibility.source: Slot inventory read off this rifle's CUSTOMIZE overview screen, 2026-08-06. No slot was opened, so which attachments each holds is not recorded.
compatibility.note: Mount is an Underbarrel option this rifle offers that the KORD 6P67 and EF88 do not. It has no page yet, because it was never selected and so was never named beyond its tile.
